investment_strategy: Barbell around A.I. secular growth: overweight durable, cash-generative platforms with positive analyst consensus (MSFT, GOOGL, AAPL) and add a capped sleeve of A.I. infrastructure leaders benefiting from the datacenter buildout (NVDA, MU). With VIX at 16.7 and the 10Y at ~3.8%, we take a moderately risk-on stance but size high-beta semis conservatively to manage volatility and policy/geopolitical risks. Focus on enterprises’ A.I.-driven productivity, device-level A.I. upgrades, and memory/network bottlenecks, while monitoring antitrust and export-control headlines.

final_recommendations.allocation_rationale: Quality anchor with strong earnings/revenue growth, consistent beats, and moderate volatility fits a moderate-risk macro tape; largest weight to balance higher-beta names.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Quality-growth core plus capped A.I. infrastructure sleeve benefiting from secular A.I. adoption, balanced against regulatory and geopolitical volatility.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Favored positive analyst consensus (Buy/Strong Buy), strong fundamental growth, supportive or improving momentum, and lower relative volatility where available. Weighted larger to durable cash-flow platforms (MSFT, GOOGL, AAPL) and smaller to high-beta semis (NVDA, MU) to reflect macro (VIX ~17, 10Y ~3.8%) and policy risk.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructively bullish long term for technology led by A.I. adoption, semiconductor upcycle, and device-level A.I. upgrades; expect episodic volatility from antitrust, export controls, and capex ROI debates. Maintain risk-aware sizing and rebalance on regulatory/geopolitical shocks.
